div.div:
score = sum of 5 fields, max 100
verdict: must_backport 30, likely_relevant 20,
needs_review 10, likely_skip / skip 0
severity: critical 25, moderate 15, low 5
affected_scope: all_users 20, specific_models 12,
specific_feature 8, edge_case 3
backport_risk: safe 15, moderate 8, risky 0
self_contained: true 10, false 0
sort: score desc, then files_in_release desc,
then change_size asc
backport_ease = ai-fixable when self_contained
and backport_risk is safe or moderate
